title: Prism Pair
description: Guide two lights into a shared constellation. Practise solo, or invite a friend for a short cooperative game.
controls: Move your light with the arrow keys or A/D, or drag across the playfield.
Align both lights with their matching rings to collect a star.
Keep the host tab open during a two-player game.
credits: Original game by Nilo for LOB7, with AI assistance.
